proofs.why: This mutation restores the pre-fix order at Table A site A1: it puts the slice(0, MAX_FIELD_CHARS) back inside the redactOnly(...) argument, so the value is cut before it is scanned instead of after. A credential straddling the cap then has only its head reach the detector, PROBE_HEAD survives, and MARKER never appears — exactly the leak this WP closed. testNamePattern scopes the phase to the one converted probe because the mutation changes how every capped field in this suite is scanned, and none of the others is this criterion's concern.
